sloka: न अराकजे जन पदे धनवन्तः सुरक्षिताः ।शेरते विवृत द्वाराः कृषि गो रक्ष जीविनः ॥२-६७-१९॥
transliteration: na arākaje jana pade dhanavantaḥ surakṣitāḥ ।śerate vivṛta dvārāḥ kṛṣi go rakṣa jīvinaḥ ॥2-67-19॥

translations.english: In a country without a king, wealthy people who live on farming and raising cattle cannot sleep safely in their homes with doors wide open.
